newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Dec deficit seen worse than Nov - cenbank.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Dec deficit seen worse than Nov - cenbank.

text.p: Brazil's federal government public sector deficit in December will probably be wider than in November because of seasonal pressures, Altamir Lopes, head of the Central Bank's economic department, said.
Lopes said the federal government's primary deficit fell to a 0.44 percent surplus of gross domestic product (GDP) in November from a 0.49 percent surplus in October because of "year-end pressures."
"In December, the pressures will certainly be the same (as in November)," Lopes told reporters. The calendar 1996 deficit figures were not yet ready, he added.

The total public sector result, which includes states and municipalities, for the year to November in primary terms was in equilibrium, compared with a deficit of 0.05 percent through October because of better performances by states, municipalities and state-owned firms.
"The January to November primary result shows a continuation of the trend of recovery which began in June," Lopes said.
